readout_other: Diffusion-weighted MRI rADC; neurobehavioural score; Nissl staining; Na+-K+-ATPase activity
direction_notes: LITUS after ET-1 induced ischaemia reduced the fall in rADC, improved neurobehavioural scores and reduced neuronal damage; strongest when applied 30 min after ischaemia. Neural excitability was not measured.

exposures.label: LITUS at 30, 120 or 240 min after ET-1

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed 500 kHz ultrasound, tone-burst duration 0.5 ms at PRF 1 kHz, stimulation duration 400 ms per train; total stimulation duration 10 min. Delivered through a 10 mm conical collimator at 30, 120 or 240 min after ET-1 injection.
